diagnostic.title: Initial assessment
diagnostic.subtitle: Set a starting point for personalized music lessons.
diagnostic.startTitle: Let's get to know your playing
diagnostic.startDescription: We will create a diagnostic session. You will be able to add familiar performances later.
diagnostic.intakeDescription: Uploading performances and scores comes later. You can continue without recordings now and preserve your progress in PostgreSQL.
diagnostic.noFilesYet: File upload is not implemented yet; this screen tests the session lifecycle.
diagnostic.readyDescription: The session is stored and waiting for its first diagnostic task. Task selection comes in the next increment.
diagnostic.noAssessment: No audio has been analyzed and no skill assessments have been made.
diagnostic.chooseStudy: Choose your first diagnostic étude. One provisional original piece is available.
diagnostic.noExercises: No études are available for this instrument yet.
diagnostic.draftWarning: The piece is accepted for the MVP prototype, but fingering and score rendering still require validation.
diagnostic.practiceTips: Start with melody only, then a steady thumb bass. Combine parts at 60–70 BPM before approaching 84 BPM. This is practice, not a graded exam.
diagnostic.tabWarning: Fret positions are shown on an eighth-note grid; use the MusicXML score for exact durations, rests and articulation.
diagnostic.catalogApiMissing: Exercise catalog API not found (HTTP 404). Make sure Spring Boot is running from feature/dev-05b-exercise-catalog rather than an older backend version.
diagnostic.synthesizedExample: This is synthesized guitar, not a teacher performance.
diagnostic.mediaNotInstalled: Preview file has not been installed in this local prototype yet. MusicXML score remains available below.
diagnostic.musicXmlAlternative: If your browser cannot display PDF inline:

attempt.title: My performance
attempt.subtitle: Submit an audio attempt and review your submission history.
attempt.noAiFeedback: AI audio analysis is not yet available. Uploaded recordings will be shown as received without assessment; no fabricated scores or errors.
attempt.disabledHelp: Uploads are disabled by default because authentication is not yet implemented. For non-personal local test audio only, start the backend with GUITAR_MENTOR_ENABLE_UPLOADS=true.
attempt.fileLimits: MP3, WAV, OGG or WebM · up to 20 MB. Test audio only; do not upload personal recordings.
attempt.commentPlaceholder: For example: I lose the steady bass in bars 5–8
attempt.uploaded: Attempt saved. No performance assessment is currently available.
attempt.sizeError: Audio must be nonempty and no larger than 20 MB.
attempt.formatError: MP3, WAV, OGG and WebM only.
attempt.receivedUnassessed: Audio received · assessment not yet available
attempt.micPrivacy: Your browser will request permission when you press Start. The recording remains in the browser until you submit it. Use test audio only for this MVP.
attempt.micUnsupported: This browser does not support a compatible recording format. Upload MP3/WAV/OGG/WebM instead.
attempt.recorderError: Recording failed. Check your microphone and retry.
attempt.recorderEmpty: The recording is empty. Please try again.
attempt.microphoneDenied: Could not access the microphone. Check browser permissions and the selected device.
